description: Full-text search of recent Arkansas Supreme Court and Court of Appeals opinions (decisions from 2026-01-01 on, from the Arkansas Judiciary's official archive) by subject, party or phrase — "parole eligibility", "termination of parental rights", "Walmart". Filter by court and decision date. Returns matching opinions with neutral citation, case name, date, a highlighted passage and a link to the opinion's own page; read the whole opinion with ark_opinion. Use quotes for an exact phrase.

date_after.description: Only decisions on or after this date, YYYY-MM-DD.

date_before.description: Only decisions on or before this date, YYYY-MM-DD.

query.description: Words or a "quoted phrase" to find in the opinion text, case name or citation.

name: ark_search_opinions
title: Ark Search Opinions
